## Plotting Calendar Plot
```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

# Paths
file_path <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Monthly risk/county_monthly_risk_wide_formate.csv"

out_dir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Output"

# Read data
df <- read_csv(file_path)

# Exact county order for plot
south_counties <- df %>%
  filter(Region == "south") %>%
  arrange(County) %>%
  pull(County)

central_counties <- df %>%
  filter(Region == "central") %>%
  arrange(County) %>%
  pull(County)

north_counties <- df %>%
  filter(Region == "north") %>%
  arrange(County) %>%
  pull(County)

# First levels go at bottom, last levels go at top
county_order <- c(south_counties, central_counties, north_counties)

region_info <- tibble(
  Region = c("south", "central", "north"),
  n = c(length(south_counties), length(central_counties), length(north_counties))
) %>%
  mutate(
    ymax = cumsum(n),
    ymin = ymax - n + 1,
    ymid = (ymin + ymax) / 2
  )

# Ordering
month_levels <- c("Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec")

# Reshape
df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = where(is.numeric),
    names_to = c("Month", "Species"),
    names_sep = "_",
    values_to = "Risk"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Month = factor(Month, levels = month_levels),
    County = factor(County, levels = county_order),
    Species = recode(
      Species,
      aa = "Amblyomma americanum",
      dv = "Dermacentor variabilis",
      is = "Ixodes scapularis"
    )
  )

# Heatmap function
make_heatmap <- function(dat, title_text, region_vjust = 26, left_margin = 140, show_legend = TRUE) {
  ggplot(dat, aes(x = Month, y = County, fill = Risk)) +
    
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = c("white", "#FFFFCC", "#FDB863", "#E66101", "#B2182B"),
      values = rescale(c(0, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1)),
      trans = "sqrt",
      name = "Risk"
    ) +
    
    scale_y_discrete(limits = county_order) +
    
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      title = title_text
    ) +
    
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = c(length(south_counties),
                     length(south_counties) + length(central_counties)) + 0.5,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    
    annotate("text",
             x = 1,
             y = region_info$ymid[region_info$Region == "south"],
             label = "South",
             angle = 90,
             fontface = "bold",
             size = 4,
             hjust = 0.5,
             vjust = region_vjust) +
    
    annotate("text",
             x = 1,
             y = region_info$ymid[region_info$Region == "central"],
             label = "Central",
             angle = 90,
             fontface = "bold",
             size = 4,
             hjust = 0.5,
             vjust = region_vjust) +
    
    annotate("text",
             x = 1,
             y = region_info$ymid[region_info$Region == "north"],
             label = "North",
             angle = 90,
             fontface = "bold",
             size = 4,
             hjust = 0.5,
             vjust = region_vjust) +
    
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.position = if (show_legend) "right" else "none",
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, left_margin)
    )
}

# Panel plots
p_aa_panel <- make_heatmap(
  df_long %>% filter(Species == "Amblyomma americanum"),
  expression(italic("Amblyomma americanum")),
  region_vjust = 39,
  left_margin = 40,
  show_legend = TRUE
)

p_dv_panel <- make_heatmap(
  df_long %>% filter(Species == "Dermacentor variabilis"),
  expression(italic("Dermacentor variabilis")),
  region_vjust = 39,
  left_margin = 40,
  show_legend = TRUE
)

p_is_panel <- make_heatmap(
  df_long %>% filter(Species == "Ixodes scapularis"),
  expression(italic("Ixodes scapularis")),
  region_vjust = 39,
  left_margin = 40,
  show_legend = TRUE
)

# Combined panel with one legend
p_panel <- (p_aa_panel + p_dv_panel + p_is_panel) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 3, guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

p_panel

# Save panel TIFF
ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "heatmap_panel_monthly_risk.tiff"),
  plot = p_panel,
  width = 18,
  height = 16,
  dpi = 300,
  compression = "lzw"
)


## Modified Pannel Plot

# remove region labels from first two plots (keep only Ixodes)
p_aa_nolab <- p_aa_panel
p_aa_nolab$layers <- p_aa_nolab$layers[-c(3,4,5)]

p_dv_nolab <- p_dv_panel
p_dv_nolab$layers <- p_dv_nolab$layers[-c(3,4,5)]

# new panel: only Ixodes has North/Central/South labels
p_panel_ixodes_only_labels <- (p_aa_nolab + p_dv_nolab + p_is_panel) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 3, guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# display it
p_panel_ixodes_only_labels

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "heatmap_panel_monthly_risk_single label.tiff"),
  plot = p_panel_ixodes_only_labels,
  width = 18,
  height = 16,
  dpi = 300,
  compression = "lzw"
)


# Individual plots with smaller left shift
p_aa <- make_heatmap(
  df_long %>% filter(Species == "Amblyomma americanum"),
  expression(italic("Amblyomma americanum")),
  region_vjust = 51,
  left_margin = 40,
  show_legend = TRUE
)

p_dv <- make_heatmap(
  df_long %>% filter(Species == "Dermacentor variabilis"),
  expression(italic("Dermacentor variabilis")),
  region_vjust = 51,
  left_margin = 40,
  show_legend = TRUE
)

p_is <- make_heatmap(
  df_long %>% filter(Species == "Ixodes scapularis"),
  expression(italic("Ixodes scapularis")),
  region_vjust = 51,
  left_margin = 40,
  show_legend = TRUE
)

# Save individual TIFFs
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "heatmap_aa.tiff"), p_aa, width = 8, height = 16, dpi = 300, compression = "lzw")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "heatmap_dv.tiff"), p_dv, width = 8, height = 16, dpi = 300, compression = "lzw")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "heatmap_is.tiff"), p_is, width = 8, height = 16, dpi = 300, compression = "lzw")

```


## Plotting Calendar Plot with distribution
```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

# Paths
file_path <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Monthly risk/county_monthly_risk_wide_formate.csv"

out_dir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Output"

# Read data
df <- read_csv(file_path)

# Ordering
month_levels <- c("Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec")

# Exact county order for plot
south_counties <- df %>%
  filter(Region == "south") %>%
  arrange(County) %>%
  pull(County)

central_counties <- df %>%
  filter(Region == "central") %>%
  arrange(County) %>%
  pull(County)

north_counties <- df %>%
  filter(Region == "north") %>%
  arrange(County) %>%
  pull(County)

# first levels bottom, last levels top
county_order <- c(south_counties, central_counties, north_counties)

region_info <- tibble(
  Region = c("south", "central", "north"),
  n = c(length(south_counties), length(central_counties), length(north_counties))
) %>%
  mutate(
    ymax = cumsum(n),
    ymin = ymax - n + 1,
    ymid = (ymin + ymax) / 2
  )

# Reshape
df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = where(is.numeric),
    names_to = c("Month", "Species"),
    names_sep = "_",
    values_to = "Risk"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Month = factor(Month, levels = month_levels),
    County = factor(County, levels = county_order),
    Species = recode(
      Species,
      aa = "Amblyomma americanum",
      dv = "Dermacentor variabilis",
      is = "Ixodes scapularis"
    )
  )

# Function to make heatmap + marginal plots
make_heatmap_with_marginals <- function(dat, title_text,
                                        region_vjust = 26,
                                        left_margin = 140,
                                        show_region_labels = TRUE,
                                        show_legend = TRUE) {
  
  # summaries
  month_marginal <- dat %>%
    group_by(Month) %>%
    summarise(Risk_month = mean(Risk, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      Month = factor(Month, levels = month_levels),
      month_id = seq_along(Month)
    )
  
  county_marginal <- dat %>%
    group_by(County) %>%
    summarise(Risk_county = mean(Risk, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      County = factor(County, levels = county_order),
      county_id = seq_along(County)
    )
  
  # heatmap
  p_heat <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = Month, y = County, fill = Risk)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = c("white", "#FFFFCC", "#FDB863", "#E66101", "#B2182B"),
      values = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1)),
      trans = "sqrt",
      name = "Risk"
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = county_order) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = title_text) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = c(length(south_counties),
                     length(south_counties) + length(central_counties)) + 0.5,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black",
                           size = 16, face = "bold"),
axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 24),
legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "black"),
legend.text  = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      legend.position = if (show_legend) "right" else "none",
      plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, left_margin)
    )
  
  if (show_region_labels) {
    p_heat <- p_heat +
      annotate("text",
               x = 1,
               y = region_info$ymid[region_info$Region == "south"],
               label = "South",
               angle = 90,
               fontface = "bold",
               size = 6,
               hjust = 0.5,
               vjust = region_vjust) +
      annotate("text",
               x = 1,
               y = region_info$ymid[region_info$Region == "central"],
               label = "Central",
               angle = 90,
               fontface = "bold",
               size = 6,
               hjust = 0.5,
               vjust = region_vjust) +
      annotate("text",
               x = 1,
               y = region_info$ymid[region_info$Region == "north"],
               label = "North",
               angle = 90,
               fontface = "bold",
               size = 6,
               hjust = 0.5,
               vjust = region_vjust)
  }
  
  # top marginal: bars + smooth/trend line
  p_top <- ggplot(month_marginal, aes(x = Month, y = Risk_month, group = 1)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#E66101", width = 0.9) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(0, 5.5, 0, left_margin)
    )
  
  # right marginal: bars + smooth/trend line
  p_right <- ggplot(county_marginal, aes(x = Risk_county, y = County)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#E66101", width = 0.9) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = county_order) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(5.5, 0, 5.5, 0)
    )
  
  p_blank <- patchwork::plot_spacer()
  
  combined <- (p_top + p_blank) /
    (p_heat + p_right) +
    plot_layout(
      widths = c(5, 1.2),
      heights = c(1.2, 5)
    )
  
  combined
}

# Create pannel plots
p_aa_marg_panel <- make_heatmap_with_marginals(
  df_long %>% filter(Species == "Amblyomma americanum"),
  expression(italic("Amblyomma americanum")),
  region_vjust = 24,
  left_margin = 140,
  show_region_labels = TRUE,
  show_legend = TRUE
)

p_dv_marg_panel <- make_heatmap_with_marginals(
  df_long %>% filter(Species == "Dermacentor variabilis"),
  expression(italic("Dermacentor variabilis")),
  region_vjust = 24,
  left_margin = 140,
  show_region_labels = TRUE,
  show_legend = TRUE
)

p_is_marg_panel <- make_heatmap_with_marginals(
  df_long %>% filter(Species == "Ixodes scapularis"),
  expression(italic("Ixodes scapularis")),
  region_vjust = 24,
  left_margin = 140,
  show_region_labels = TRUE,
  show_legend = TRUE
)


p_all_marg <- (p_aa_marg_panel | p_dv_marg_panel | p_is_marg_panel) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 3, guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

#save

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "heatmap_panel_monthly_risk_with_marginals.tiff"),
  plot = p_all_marg,
  width = 30,
  height = 16,
  dpi = 300,
  compression = "lzw"
)


# creat individual plots
p_aa_marg <- make_heatmap_with_marginals(
  df_long %>% filter(Species == "Amblyomma americanum"),
  expression(italic("Amblyomma americanum")),
  region_vjust = 19,

  show_legend = TRUE
)

#save
ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "heatmap_aa_with_marginals.tiff"),
  plot = p_aa_marg,
  width = 10,
  height = 16,
  dpi = 300,
  compression = "lzw"
)


p_dv_marg <- make_heatmap_with_marginals(
  df_long %>% filter(Species == "Dermacentor variabilis"),
  expression(italic("Dermacentor variabilis")),
  region_vjust = 19,
  left_margin = 80,
  show_region_labels = TRUE,
  show_legend = TRUE
)

#save
ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "heatmap_dv_with_marginals.tiff"),
  plot = p_dv_marg,
  width = 10,

  dpi = 300,
  compression = "lzw"
)



p_is_marg <- make_heatmap_with_marginals(
  df_long %>% filter(Species == "Ixodes scapularis"),
  expression(italic("Ixodes scapularis")),
  region_vjust = 19,
  left_margin = 80,

  show_legend = TRUE

#save

  width = 10,
```
